title: fix(core,plugin-detail,app-shell): the related list, reference rail and packaged-actions table draw a served object label as served
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuEv8Fwf2b7dKNmdsotnksFm)_

Fixes #30486

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录页上没写标题的相关列表、引用侧栏卡片，以及「设置 › 打包动作」表的对象列，改为显示服务端下发的对象名（含 `.custom` 扩展里的改名）；只有服务端没下发名称时才查前端翻译目录。打包动作读对象列表时带上会话语言。
- 为什么改：客户在 `.custom` 扩展里把对象改名后，这三处仍显示基础包的旧译名（实测：服务端下发 Work items，界面显示 任务 / Tasks），同一个对象出现两个名字；打包动作表读对象时带的是浏览器语言而非会话语言。
- 风险与回滚：未改名的对象显示不变（服务端下发的就是目录译文）。规则从 app-shell 移到 `@object-ui/core`（plugin-detail 引用不到 app-shell），新增 5 个导出，app-shell 原文件改为转出，行为逐字不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/utils/served-object-label.ts`（搬来的规则，函数体未改）、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx`（新增一次与 RelatedList 同键同源的 schema 读取）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedActionsSection.tsx`（`Accept-Language` 与对象列）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.titlePlural-11733.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-reference-rail.titlePlural-11733.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedActionsSection.test.tsx`，预期全绿，其中 objectstack#30486 分组断言改名后的对象名胜过目录旧译名。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The served-object-label rule (PR #30388, PR #30475) reaches the three sites the card names. Each was measured on `origin/main` `8e5fabe5` first, live, and all three were still wrong (readings below), so none is reported as already correct.

- **Rule home.** `@object-ui/plugin-detail` cannot import `@object-ui/app-shell` (app-shell depends on it), so the rule moves, function bodies unchanged, from app-shell's private `hooks/servedObjectLabel.ts` to `ui/packages/core/src/utils/served-object-label.ts`, a package both already import that holds no provider and already reads `@objectstack/spec/ui` at runtime. Named exports from the core entry: `servedObjectLabel`, `servedObjectPluralLabel`, `metadataText`, `ObjectLabelLookup`, `ObjectPluralLabelLookup` (hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)`). app-shell's file is now a re-export, so its 30-odd importers are untouched. Core over `@object-ui/react` or `@object-ui/i18n`: about 400 app-shell and plugin-detail test files mock those two packages with factories, and core is mocked by none of them.
- **Related list** (`record-related-list.tsx`): an untitled block reads the related object's served definition with `useSettledSchema(objectName, ctx.dataSource)`, the same key and data source the inner `RelatedList` already reads for its columns (the adapter's metadata cache answers both), and names the list by `servedObjectPluralLabel`, the bundle plural and then the humanized name as before when nothing is served.
- **Reference rail** (`record-reference-rail.tsx`): the rail already reads each related object's schema for its fields and name field; it now also keeps that schema's `label` / `pluralLabel`, and both names (the card title and the empty line) read `servedObjectPluralLabel`.
- **Packaged actions** (`PackagedActionsSection.tsx`, `packagedActions.ts` doc only): the `GET /meta/object` read sends `Accept-Language` with the session language (`useObjectTranslation().language`, also an effect dependency), and the object column draws the served label through `servedObjectLabel` instead of the bundle-first `objectLabel`.
- One root changeset, `patch` for `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Tests

- New pins, each an objectstack#30486 top-level `describe` in the component's existing harness file: `record-related-list.titlePlural-11733.test.tsx` (served rename en / zh, served label without plural), `record-reference-rail.titlePlural-11733.test.tsx` (card and empty line en / zh, plus a no-label control), `PackagedActionsSection.test.tsx` (the object read's `Accept-Language`, served rename en / zh, no-label control). The existing bundle cases in those files stay as the controls for the not-served path.
- Reverse verification on `65c0b85f`: with the three source files restored to `8e5fabe5` (tree only), `Tests 8 failed | 27 passed (35)`, the 8 being exactly the new served-name cases; restored from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Targeted run: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 61 passed (61)` (the three files plus `servedObjectLabel-30390.test.ts` and `packagedActions.test.ts`).
- Consumer sweep on `688f24a4`: every app-shell test file importing a module that imports `servedObjectLabel` or `useNavTargetLabel` (669 files), plus the whole `plugin-detail` and `core` suites: `Test Files 1274 passed | 1 skipped (1275)`, `Tests 12687 passed | 45 skipped (12732)`.
- `type-check` (both tsconfigs) for `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: all Done, exit 0. eslint on the 10 changed files: 0 errors (28 existing warnings).

## Acceptance notes

- The branch is the card thread's harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-28n2uz`, not `claude/issue-30486-*`.
- The live rig names the object through an `object_extension` in `com.example.showcase.custom` (label `Work item`, plural `Work items`, plain strings, so a zh-CN session is served the English rename too). The served list label in zh-CN is `Work items`, the base translation `任务`.
- Not changed, observed on the same page: the sidebar navigation entry and the authored tab label still say `任务` / `Tasks`. Both are their own authored labels (an app navigation item, a page tab), not an object-name lookup, so they are outside this rule.
- `#30126` row 6 (plugin-detail record-page field labels): no file overlap; this PR touches only the two renderers named above in plugin-detail.

## Verification

Live: showcase `objectstack dev --fresh` with the `.custom` rename above and a `.custom` override of `showcase_project_detail` whose Related tab holds an untitled `record:related_list` and an untitled `record:reference_rail` entry for `showcase_task`; Console from `ui/apps/console` vite, 1440 px. Three sessions: en-US browser, zh-CN browser, and a zh-CN session in an en-US browser.

| Reading | before `8e5fabe5` | after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Related list + rail title, en-US | Tasks, Tasks | Work items, Work items |
| Related list + rail title, zh-CN | 任务, 任务 | Work items, Work items |
| Packaged actions, `showcase_task` object column, en-US / zh-CN | Task / 任务 | Work item / Work item |
| Packaged actions, the section's `/meta/object` `Accept-Language`, zh-CN session in an en-US browser | en-US | zh-CN |
| Control: `sys_team` (not renamed), zh-CN session in an en-US browser | 团队 | 团队 |

Record page, zh-CN, before and after:

![before zh-CN](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/5ebc6c24151041487d35169abcf8a76b3bd84cb8/evidence/30486/before-1-record-related-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true)
![after zh-CN](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/5ebc6c24151041487d35169abcf8a76b3bd84cb8/evidence/30486/after-1-record-related-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true)

Packaged actions, zh-CN: [before](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/5ebc6c24151041487d35169abcf8a76b3bd84cb8/evidence/30486/before-2-packaged-actions-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true) · [after](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/5ebc6c24151041487d35169abcf8a76b3bd84cb8/evidence/30486/after-2-packaged-actions-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true). en-US: [before](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/5ebc6c24151041487d35169abcf8a76b3bd84cb8/evidence/30486/before-2-packaged-actions-en-US-1440.png?raw=true) · [after](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/5ebc6c24151041487d35169abcf8a76b3bd84cb8/evidence/30486/after-2-packaged-actions-en-US-1440.png?raw=true). zh-CN session, en-US browser: [before](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/5ebc6c24151041487d35169abcf8a76b3bd84cb8/evidence/30486/before-2-packaged-actions-zh-CN-session-en-browser-1440.png?raw=true) · [after](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/5ebc6c24151041487d35169abcf8a76b3bd84cb8/evidence/30486/after-2-packaged-actions-zh-CN-session-en-browser-1440.png?raw=true).
